name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.4 (TEST): for an embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME container the forward is redirected into a reply (recipients cleared, Re: -> Fwd:); standalone files are extracted in the parent scope with Thunderbird's own gloda MsgHdrToMimeMessage (which, unlike the messages API, descends into embedded rfc822 S/MIME) and their part URLs are fetched with NetUtil.asyncFetch (loadUsingSystemPrincipal) to bypass the nullprincipal block, then re-attached to the compose window.
